title: Zun-Muram Votal
summary: Keep Votal and his two Pixtt guards inside their encounter area.
overview: Votal brings both Pixtt guards into the fight, and the guards call one another and Votal when engaged. Plan for a linked pull instead of isolated enemies.

roles.label: Tanks
tips: Keep the fight south of the boundary and assign coverage for both guards.

abilities.name: Encounter boundary
abilities.summary: Crossing north of Y -400 sends these enemies home.
description: The reviewed Votal and Pixtt scripts check the boundary every six seconds, return the NPC to its bind location and clear its hate list.

sections.title: Guard recovery
paragraphs: Votal creates the guards while idle. A 30-minute replacement timer begins on initial engagement; if he is still fighting when it expires, the replacement waits until combat ends.

notes: Approved row E123. Quest source reviewed; live encounter behavior and loaded database spell/loot data have not been verified.
